_about: One environment of a real Dockhand 1.0.57 instance as ha-dockhand 2.0's coordinators hold it, from a diagnostics download, with names, addresses, paths, ids and finding counts replaced and some containers left out. tests/test_real_data.py sets the integration up from it.
